tasks.short: Prepare for and coordinate the year-end and internal audits: evidence, control tests, auditor queries, findings.

steps.what: Receive auditor request list, assign items, chase owners by mail
Pull trial balance, ledger extracts, reconciliations and supporting documents
Test controls and sample transactions: approvals, duplicates, IBAN changes, manual journals
Answer auditor queries in mail and meetings with linked evidence

loop.input: auditor query text plus the indexed audit evidence folder and control test results
loop.output: draft answer citing specific evidence files and ledger lines
loop.check: every cited file and amount must exist in the evidence index and tie to the AFAS extract; drafts without a citation are discarded
loop.stop: one draft per query, at most two retries; on failure the query goes to the controller unanswered
loop.why_not_simpler: auditor queries are free text and differ every year, so a fixed lookup cannot map them to evidence

steps.what: Judge findings, agree adjustments, write management letter response

tasks.design: A SharePoint list replaces the mailed request list: each auditor item has an owner, due date and Teams reminder. A scheduled Python job pulls AFAS data through GetConnectors into a dated evidence folder and runs full-population control tests (duplicate payments, supplier IBAN changes, journals posted by approvers, approval limits), feeding a Power BI exception page. A bounded model step drafts answers to auditor queries with citations to that folder; the controller sends them.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence gathering meant manual AFAS exports per request and control tests were done on samples in Excel because full-population scripts took too long to build for a once-a-year job.
tasks.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding makes small extract and test scripts on the AFAS connectors cheap to build and keep up to date, and models can now reliably map a free-text query to indexed evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding what an exception means, which findings are material, and negotiating adjustments with the auditor stay judgement work; the evidence index must stay complete or drafts go wrong.
tasks.human_edge: The controller knows why a transaction looks odd (a one-off agency deal, a site move) and carries the relationship with the external auditor.

ambition.what: Run the full control test set every month instead of once at year-end, so issues are fixed before the auditor arrives.

tasks.altitude: Audit weeks shrink from chasing files to reviewing exceptions; the controller decides the monthly control test set and its thresholds.

reach.task: Changing supplier bank details in AFAS
reach.learn: Which IBAN-change patterns the control test flags and how to verify them by phone before the next payment batch.
How the evidence folder expects reconciliations to be named and tied so they serve the audit without rework.

evidence.claim: Close work fails on accounting judgement more than on retrieval, so findings and adjustments stay with the person.
An estimate or answer the auditor cannot rebuild is a risk when prompts and outputs sit in personal accounts; drafts must be logged on the governed platform.
AFAS bank matching runs on fixed rules on reference, IBAN and invoice number, so its unmatched remainder is a natural control-test input.
Full-population duplicate and IBAN-change tests are standard deterministic analytics.

assumptions: The external auditor accepts evidence shared through a SharePoint folder.
AFAS GetConnectors expose journal entries with user and timestamp.
unknowns: Does Noordhaven run an internal audit function or only the statutory audit?
Which AFAS modules and connectors are licensed and who grants API access?
Does the works council see user-level journal tests as employee monitoring needing consent (WOR art. 27)?
research_questions: Which share of last year's auditor requests could have been answered from a standard AFAS extract?
How many control exceptions would a monthly full-population test have found, and how many were real issues?
Will the audit firm rely on Noordhaven's own control test output, or redo it anyway?

tasks.short: Prepare the annual corporate tax (VPB) pack so the external tax adviser can complete and file the return.

steps.what: Pull final trial balance, fixed asset register and cost details
Build commercial-to-fiscal reconciliation: non-deductible costs, fiscal depreciation, investment deductions

loop.input: ledger lines on mixed accounts (representation, gifts, fines, car costs) with description and supplier
loop.output: proposed fiscal category per line (deductible, partly deductible, non-deductible, investment-deduction candidate) with a reason
loop.check: fixed GL-to-fiscal mapping handles clean accounts first; model output only on mixed accounts, totals must tie to the trial balance, low-confidence lines go to a review list
loop.stop: one pass per line, lines above a set amount or below confidence go to the controller; no retries beyond one
loop.why_not_simpler: mixed accounts hold free-text descriptions that a GL mapping cannot split into fiscal categories

steps.what: Assemble tax pack with supporting documents and notes
Answer tax adviser questions and review the draft return
Approve the return for filing and book the tax position

tasks.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform pulls the final AFAS trial balance, asset register and ledger lines, applies a maintained GL-to-fiscal mapping table and generates the fiscal reconciliation and tax pack in a fixed Excel and Word format on SharePoint. A bounded model step classifies only the lines on mixed accounts; the controller reviews those, answers the adviser and approves filing, which the adviser does with the Belastingdienst.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work is yearly and small, so building a fiscal mapping and pack generator never paid off against a few days in Excel; mixed-account lines needed a person to read every description.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding makes a once-a-year generator cheap to build and maintain, and a model can pre-sort free-text ledger lines on mixed accounts with a tie-out check.
tasks.still_hard: Fiscal choices (depreciation limits on buildings, investment deductions, provisions) need tax judgement and change with yearly rules; the adviser still owns the return.
tasks.human_edge: The controller decides the tax positions to take, knows the business facts behind odd lines, and carries the accountability toward the Belastingdienst together with the adviser.

ambition.what: Produce a quarterly estimated fiscal reconciliation so the VPB provision and preliminary assessments are right during the year, not fixed in the annual return.

tasks.altitude: Tax season becomes a review of a generated pack and a short adviser session; the controller decides the fiscal mapping and which positions go to the adviser.

reach.learn: Which cost types (gifts, fines, representation) need their own GL account so the fiscal split is clean at source.
How the estimated tax charge from the quarterly fiscal reconciliation feeds the forecast's net profit and cash.

evidence.claim: Tax estimates need mandatory human review and approval with timestamped logs.
Products in the close space draft entries and leave review and approval to people.
Benchmarks are US GAAP; Dutch fiscal rules and returns are untested for models.
Large companies must file accounts with KVK via SBR from FY2025 and AFAS cannot do this for them, a related annual filing step outside this task.

assumptions: An external tax adviser prepares and files the VPB return; Noordhaven prepares the data.
VAT returns are handled monthly by the accountants and are not part of this task.
unknowns: Is Noordhaven part of a fiscal unity (fiscale eenheid) with other entities?
What format does the tax adviser want the pack in, and does their software accept a structured import?
How many ledger lines sit on mixed accounts each year?
research_questions: How many hours did the controller and adviser spend on last year's pack, split by gathering and judging?
What share of last year's fiscal adjustments came from mixed accounts a model would have had to classify?
Would the tax adviser lower their fee for a standard, tied-out pack?

tasks.short: Decide capitalisation and depreciation of assets and advise on buying, leasing or selling trucks, forklifts and racking.

steps.what: Review capex invoices and decide capitalise or expense and asset class

loop.input: invoice lines above the capitalisation threshold with supplier, description and cost centre
loop.output: proposed asset class and useful life with a reason, or 'expense'
loop.check: rules first (amount threshold, GL account, known suppliers); model only on the rest; proposals outside the asset class list are rejected
loop.stop: one pass per invoice; low confidence or above a set amount goes to the controller
loop.why_not_simpler: invoice descriptions for equipment, repairs and improvements are free text that rules alone cannot split

steps.what: Set useful lives, methods and residual values per asset class
Run monthly depreciation and tie the asset register to the ledger
Model lease versus buy versus dispose for fleet and warehouse equipment
Advise management in a memo and meeting, agree the decision

tasks.design: AFAS fixed assets is configured with asset classes, default lives and an automatic monthly depreciation run, with a deterministic tie-out of register to ledger shown in Power BI. A rules-plus-model check proposes the asset class for new capex invoices for the controller to accept. A standard Python lease-buy-dispose model reads the register, maintenance costs and lease quotes and produces a comparison (NPV, cash, P&L effect under Dutch GAAP and fiscal depreciation) that the controller turns into advice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Lease-buy questions came one by one, so each got a fresh Excel model; capex coding relied on the controller reading invoices because descriptions are inconsistent.
tasks.enabler_now: A reusable model is now cheap to build with AI coding, and a bounded model step can pre-classify invoice descriptions with a fixed class list as the check.
tasks.still_hard: Useful life of trucks and racking, residual values and the business case for a site depend on plans the data does not hold; impairment calls stay judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The controller weighs operational plans, site strategy and risk with management, and owns the depreciation policy the auditor tests.

ambition.what: A standing fleet and equipment review twice a year for the three site managers, showing which forklifts and trucks to replace, lease or sell.

tasks.altitude: Less time on capex coding and one-off models; the controller decides the asset class policy and brings a regular replacement advice to site management.

reach.learn: How the lease-buy model's outcomes and planned depreciation feed the forecast so capex and P&L stay consistent.
Which invoice signals mark a capital item so it is routed to the asset proposal instead of expensed.

evidence.claim: Close products draft entries and flag outliers for review and approval, the same draft-then-approve pattern used for capex proposals.
Nothing should post until the tie-out checks pass; the model drafts and the tie-out decides.
Close tasks fail mainly on accounting judgement, which is where useful lives and impairment sit.
AFAS Profit has a fixed assets module with automatic depreciation runs.

assumptions: The AFAS fixed assets module is licensed or can be added.
Maintenance and utilisation data for trucks and forklifts exist in some system or file.
unknowns: Is the fixed asset register kept in AFAS or in an Excel file today?
Where do maintenance costs and running hours of trucks and forklifts live?
How many lease-buy-dispose questions does management raise per year?
research_questions: How many capex invoices per year need a capitalisation decision, and how often was the first coding wrong?
Did last year's audit raise adjustments on fixed assets or depreciation?
Would site managers act on a twice-yearly replacement review, and what data would they trust?

role.altitude: The controller moves from gathering and building files for audits, tax and assets to setting the rules: the control test set, the fiscal mapping, the asset class policy and the thresholds where a person must decide. Generated packs and drafts arrive tied out; the controller reviews exceptions and spends the freed time with auditors, the tax adviser and management.
reach: Accountant: balance sheet reconciliations built so they serve the audit directly
Bookkeeper: invoice coding and IBAN changes that feed control tests and capex proposals
FP&A Analyst: forecast that takes tax charge and depreciation from the same generated sources
Finance Director: monthly control results as input for the risk and audit committee
skills_to_grow: Specifying rules and tie-out checks precisely enough for a data engineer or AI coding tool to build
Reading and maintaining simple Python or SQL jobs on AFAS connectors
Setting review thresholds and logging so the auditor can rebuild every model-drafted item
Dutch fiscal rules for logistics assets and investment deductions
role.ambitious_version: Audit evidence, control tests, the tax pack and the asset register run as monthly generated outputs on one governed platform, so the year-end audit and tax return become a review of what was already checked each month, cutting audit adjustments and days to close.
